column1: # The audit returned 231 rows. 227 are accepted below. The four rejected are
# recorded here with their reason so the next pass does not re-litigate them:
#   kef-coda-w / USB-C Inter-Speaker Link          REJECT (typed usb)
#     Both are POWERED speakers ("all-in-one wireless bookshelf speaker
#     system ... 70W + ..."), so the link between the two cabinets carries
#     a digital signal over USB-C, not an amplified one. `usb` is correct.
#     Unity Pro Bass are bass COMBOS, so the cabinet link leaves a powered
#     unit, and every other port on the entry is line or instrument. A
#     speaker-level feed on XLR would be unusual enough to need a manual
#     to confirm, and nothing in the entry does.
#     This one is probably speaker-level, and that is exactly why it is not
#     in a mechanical sweep. TONEX Capture sits between an amp and its cab,
#     so "FROM AMP Input" carries the same amplified signal as "Cabinet
#     Output" — but the audit only matches the port whose NAME says cabinet,
#     so accepting this row alone would leave one end of one signal path
#     retyped and the other still `line`. The entry needs both ports looked
